usedFor: PayHere holds the payments, and Google Drive grants access with “Share File” after “Payment Received”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A received payment is a sensible cue to give a specific person access to a file.

watchOut: “Subscription Cancelled” can also start “Share File”, so keep cancellations on a separate path from paid ones.
